transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming today. To start off, can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me. Um... well, I guess I came in because... I've just been having a bit of a hard time lately. I mean, I don't want to make a huge deal out of it, but I just keep beating myself up about work. 

I keep feeling like... well, like I'm not really senior material, and that I've somehow fooled everyone into thinking I could handle more than I actually can. It's probably just me overthinking things, honestly, and I feel a little silly even bringing it up... but I just didn't want to let my team down. Is that... is that the sort of thing it's okay to come in here for?
How long have you been feeling this way about your abilities at work—did it start recently after something specific happened, or has this been going on for months or longer?

Well, um... nothing specific happened to trigger it, really. I don't want to make it sound worse than it is, because I definitely still get my work done and everything. But, um... looking back on it, I guess these sort of low periods, where I feel really guilty and doubt myself, they've been hanging around off and on for... maybe about eleven months? Give or take? 

I hope I'm explaining that right. I usually just try to keep my head down and push through it, you know, so it's not like it's an everyday thing. Is... is that the kind of timeline you were looking for?
Over these past 11 months, would you say you've been feeling this low, guilty mood more days than not, or does it come and go with clear stretches where you feel completely back to your normal self?

Well, um... I guess if I'm being completely honest, it's probably more days than not. I really don't want to sound like I'm just complaining, because I'm still getting everything done and I'm not letting things fall apart or anything. 

But, yeah, most days lately I've just had this... this kind of heavy, low feeling. It's almost like... like I'm just moving through work and home, but with the color turned down? If that makes sense. I try really hard not to let it show to anyone else, so I hope I'm not making a bigger deal out of it than I should. Does... does that answer what you were asking?
Besides the low mood and self-doubt, have you noticed any changes in your sleep, appetite, energy, or concentration, or any thoughts about death or not wanting to be around, during this time?

Well, um... I really don't want to sound like I'm falling apart, because I'm honestly not. I'm still functioning fine. But, um... I guess my sleep has been a little off lately. 

It's probably just normal stress, you know? But sometimes I wake up way too early, just... thinking about client tickets and work stuff, and then I just can't seem to drift off again. Or, um, on the nights where I do get a full eight hours, I still wake up feeling pretty worn out. 

I'm sure it's just because I'm not managing my stress well enough, and I don't want to complain about being a little tired. I haven't really noticed changes in my appetite or anything like that, and I definitely haven't had any... any thoughts about not wanting to be around. I would never want to do that to my family. Is... is it normal to have sleep issues like that when you're just a bit stressed?

Before these past 11 months, had you ever gone through similar stretches of feeling low, guilty, or self-doubting in the past—say, over the last couple of years—or is this the first time you've really noticed this kind of pattern?

Well, um... I really don't think so. I mean, I'm sure I've had bad weeks here and there, just like anyone else, right? But... no, I wouldn't say I've ever had a stretch like this before, where it just kind of... lingers for so long. 

I've always been pretty good at just shaking things off and focusing on my work. So this is... this is kind of new for me, which is probably why I'm not handling it as well as I should be. I'm really trying not to let it become a big thing, though. I hope it's okay that I don't have a history of this to tell you about... is it normal for it to just show up like this out of nowhere?
Have you noticed a change in how much you enjoy or look forward to things you used to like doing—hobbies, time with family, or anything else—compared to before this started?

Well, um... I mean, I'm still doing stuff, you know? I don't want you to think I'm just sitting around doing nothing. But, um... I guess maybe I haven't been quite as excited about things lately? 

Like, usually I really look forward to the weekends. I've got this great grill setup, and I love putting on a record and just relaxing, or maybe going fishing. But lately... I don't know, I just kind of leave the stuff sitting there. It's like I just don't really care as much right now? 

I'm sure it's just a phase, though. I probably just need to force myself to get out there and do it, right? I'm really trying not to be lazy about it. Do you think that's just part of being stressed out, losing interest like that?
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating or focusing on tasks at work during this time, and if so, has it affected your ability to complete your work?

Well, um... I really wouldn't say I'm having trouble concentrating. I mean, my performance at work is still totally fine, and I'm definitely getting all my tickets done on time. I don't want you to think I'm slipping at my job or anything. 

I guess maybe... sometimes I have to read an email twice to really absorb it, or it takes me a little longer to get into the groove of a project. But I think that's just because I'm a little tired, like I mentioned before, you know? It's really not a big deal, and it hasn't stopped me from doing what I need to do. I always make sure my work gets done. That's just a normal part of being a little stressed, right? Just being a tiny bit distracted sometimes?
Just to make sure I have the timeline right—has this low, guilty mood really only been going on for about 11 months, or has it actually been present, even mildly, for two years or more?

Well, um... yeah, I'd say it's really just been the last 11 months or so. I mean, looking back, these kind of off-and-on stretches where I feel down or, you know, guilty about things... they've been hanging around for about 11 months. 

I definitely wouldn't say it's been two years. I mean, I don't want to make it sound worse than it is, and I was doing really well before this started. I've always been a pretty upbeat guy, so this is just a recent thing. I hope that makes sense? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right timeline so I'm not overcomplicating things for you.
